text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? T-This is bad!
Even though I decided to do special training
for the next quiz!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right... Time to get pumped up again!
All that's left is copying basic formulas,
just 10 whole notebooks' worth...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory was all fired up to improve her grades.
However, her full-guts study method seems to have
completely exhausted her stamina...
